_: Editorial for polo-shadow. Fabric, fit, size guide, marquee, closing CTA and cross-sell come from _family-polo-classic.json.

buyBody: Gray camo, built out of four-leaf clovers. You have to be close to see what the pattern is actually made of, which is most of the fun of it.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body. Needs one close crop as a second frame. The clover reveal is the entire idea and it is invisible at full-body distance.
